name: Pionerka bez originala
source:
Have you ever wondered what place a certain very talkative and equally cheerful pioneer girl named Miku occupies in Sovyonok? What does she live for, what does she think about, and what is she capable of in the difficult moments of her life? If not, then it's time to start wondering, and this story will help you with that! Because here, none other than Miku acts as the protagonist!

Life in the camp goes on as usual, but one fine day, Miku gets a reason to doubt the normalcy of the things around her. She learns that not everything in Sovyonok is as simple as it seems. One oddity follows another. And all of this starts happening almost simultaneously with the arrival of a mysterious newcomer named Semyon at the camp. Miku sets herself the goal of unraveling the mysteries of Sovyonok and learning the whole truth about this pioneer camp and about herself. But will she withstand all the trials that are in store for her?

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1095112069]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你有没有想过，那个名叫未来、既健谈又活泼的少先队女孩，在“小猫头鹰”里究竟扮演着怎样的角色？她为何而活，又在想些什么？当人生遭遇困境时，她又能做到些什么？如果你从未想过，现在就该开始思考了，而这个故事会帮助你找到答案！因为这一次，担任主人公的不是别人，正是未来！

夏令营的生活一如往常，但某一天，一件事让未来开始怀疑，周遭的一切是否真的正常。她发现“小猫头鹰”并不像表面上那么简单，怪事接二连三地发生。而这一切，几乎都始于一个名叫谢米扬的神秘新人来到夏令营之后。未来决心解开“小猫头鹰”的谜团，查明这座少先队夏令营以及她自身的全部真相。然而，等待着她的种种考验，她真能承受得住吗？

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1095112069]Steam[/url]]
